welcome.title: Welcome to CamTrap Verify
welcome.subtitle: This tool lets you verify the presence of a species at specific locations and time periods, confirming or discarding the automatic detections. When you're done, you'll get a CamtrapDP with the confirmed observations marked as human-reviewed, along with naive vs. verified detection histories ready for occupancy models.

gallery.title: Detection verification
gallery.intro_hint: The detection events shown below are separated by {{gap}} seconds, captured at different locations and time occasions of {{days}} days, corresponding to observations with a detection confidence of {{minScore}} or higher. For each one, confirm whether the detection event contains one or more individuals of the species {{species}}. If you confirm the species' presence in a detection event, its presence will be considered verified for that location during the corresponding time occasion, and no further detection events from that same occasion will need to be reviewed. If you cannot confirm its presence, a new detection event captured at the same location and during the same time occasion will be shown to continue the verification.
gallery.round_hint: In round {{n}}, each sampling occasion is represented by the detection event with the highest detection confidence among those not yet reviewed.
gallery.needs_decision: Mark all detection events before saving.

gallery.unsure_tooltip: Not clear: another detection event of this occasion will be shown in the next round. If none gets confirmed, the occasion stays pending expert review instead of counting as not detected.

gallery.pending_hint: These occasions ran out of detection events without a confirmation, and at least one was marked unsure. For each one, confirm presence (the event you are viewing is recorded), mark it as rejected, or leave it unsure for someone else to review. You can save without deciding all of them.

gallery.toast_pending_saved: Saved. {{n}} occasions still pending expert review.
gallery.round_hint_unsure: In round {{n}}, each sampling occasion is represented by the detection event with the highest detection confidence among those not yet reviewed. help.title: Help — CamTrap Verify
help.what_body: A tool for iteratively reviewing and validating species detections from camera traps. It takes a CamtrapDP directory as input and produces a new CamtrapDP with the verification status of each record.
workflow_steps: Configure the CamtrapDP directory, target species, study period and sampling parameters.
For each species, review sampling occasions one by one.
Each occasion shows the detection event with the highest detection confidence. Confirm or reject it.
When you save, if any occasions remain unconfirmed, a second round opens with the next detection event for each occasion.
Once all species are complete, go to Results to export the verified CamtrapDP.

concepts.def: A time window of N days per location. All images from the same site within that window form one occasion.
A group of images taken at the same location less than N seconds apart (configured under 'Gap between detection events').
Each round shows the highest-confidence unreviewed detection event for each occasion. If rejected in round 1, the next lower-confidence detection event appears in round 2.
The maximum classification probability across all images in a detection event, as assigned by the AI model.

help.decisions_body: Confirming means the species is present in that occasion and location. Rejecting means the detection is incorrect. An occasion closes as soon as one detection event is confirmed.

results.title: Verification results
results.subtitle: Each row is an event — unique combination of site × occasion × species.
results.datapackage_generated: The exported package's datapackage.json was auto-generated because the source had none. The following fields are placeholders, not derived from your data — edit them before treating this as a citable/archival package:
results.output_hint: The session folder contains two subdirectories: camtrap_dp_verified/ with the original CamtrapDP modified — confirmed observations have classificationMethod='human', classificationProbability=1.0 and classifiedBy='expert_review'; and occupancy_inputs/ with per-species naive and verified detection histories (dethist_naive_*.csv, dethist_verified_*.csv) plus cell_status_*.csv, giving the status of each cell (1, 0, pending, unreviewed or inactive), a camera operation matrix, a verification summary and a review effort report.
results.occupancy_hint: Comparison of occupancy (ψ) and detection (p) probabilities estimated from the unreviewed detections versus the manually verified ones. Intervals are 95% confidence intervals.
results.pending_title: {{n}} occasions are still pending expert review
results.pending_hint: They appear as NA in dethist_verified_*.csv, just like occasions with an inactive camera. To tell them apart, see cell_status_*.csv (values pending and inactive). You can export the session from the species index so that someone else reviews them.

mc.title: Combine several classifiers
mc.desc: Each classifier is a CamtrapDP folder of the same photos (e.g. DeepFaune, a YOLO model and the volunteers' labels of Zooniverse). They are combined into one probability per photo and species, the scoring method is chosen with the reference, and the detection events that are not worth reviewing are removed. The result is a new CamtrapDP that the session then uses.
mc.classifiers_desc: AI classifiers propose detections. The reference (optional) is taken as truth: it is used to measure the AI classifiers, learn how much to trust each one and choose the method.
mc.name: Name
mc.reference_hint: Photos are matched by mediaID: every folder must use the same IDs.
mc.period_hint: {{n}} photos in the AI classifiers' folders. The session will use this same period, occasion length and gap.
mc.species_desc: Tick the target species. A group is what a classifier can say without naming the species (e.g. Cervidae for red and fallow deer): species of the same group are scored together and then split animal by animal.
mc.label: Label
mc.no_reference: Without a reference the probabilities are combined by agreement between classifiers and no events are removed.
mc.filter_cells_hint: Per species, the highest threshold that still keeps a true event in the chosen share of the cells (site × occasion) where the reference confirms the species.
mc.filter_events_hint: Per species, the threshold that keeps the chosen share of the reference's true events. Removes fewer events; use it if events are used for counts or rates.
mc.filter_none_hint: Nothing is removed: only the order of the events changes.
mc.tie_ambiguous: Fewest photos split between two species
mc.use_reference: Photos reviewed by the reference: use its verdict (confirmed go up, rejected go down)
mc.running: Running: this can take a few minutes on large archives.
